summary: The manuscript presents an exceptionally rigorous, dual-layer verification framework for graph state-sum contractions on paths, binary trees, and square grids. Layer 1 provides a machine-checked Lean 4 kernel (18 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 warnings) establishing small-graph identities and arithmetic bounds, while Layer 2 (VALIANT-HIER-CERT-1.0) implements a pure-stdlib Python exact rational evaluator that replays 16 canonical certificates and successfully repels all 54 adversarial test attacks. The authors maintain exemplary intellectual honesty through explicit non-claims.
weaknesses: Formal machine-checked proofs are restricted to fixed small graph instances, whereas general problem sizes rely on Python certificate auditing.
